tenderSchedule.title: Procurement of Cartridge Filter Element
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Purchase Office BTPS Bellary

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.

The intending bidder should have supplied Cartridge Filter Element of purchase order worth not less than Rs.1.22Lakhs for power plant/ any process industries in a single purchase order in the preceding five financial years and PO copy shall be uploaded in e-portal (signed past PO copy as a proof).

The intending bidder shall be a Manufacturer (OEM) /OES/ Authorized Dealer/ Supplier for Cartridge Filter Element. As a proof the bidder shall upload valid registration certificate issued by competent authority in case of manufactures & dealership certificate from manufacturer in case of authorized dealers

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.2.45Lakhs for any two years during preceding five financial years. As a proof, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account or turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should submit 2 Nos of Catridge Filter elements as sample to the purchaser on returnable basis. Only the sample approved bidders pricebid will be opened. Purchaser decision is the final.
tenderTechnicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: sample to the purchaser on returnable basis

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- sample to the purchaser on returnable basis

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have GST registrations & shall furnish copy of certificate as a documentary proof.
The declaration duly signed in the prescribed format (Annexure - II) has to be enclosed.
